- **~380ms Perceived Voice Latency (-79% Dead Air):** Engineered a Dynamic Contextual Filler engine (<120ms intent classification + pre-warmed audio bridge) masking 1,850ms sequential Voice AI + RAG + CRM wait times.
- **-90% Fintech Platform Latency (2,400ms to 240ms):** Re-architected Growwth Partners' core fintech web platform using bidirectional WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub while accelerating release velocity by +40%.
- **Empirical MLflow Medical RAG Evaluation (0.9471 / 1.1417 NDCG@10):** Benchmarked Qdrant v1.12.4 + AWS Bedrock Titan v2 + Claude Sonnet 4.5 + LangGraph across 100-doc and 300-doc PubMedQA sweeps, proving agentic relevance grading rescues noisy BM25 hybrid retrieval by +15.3% NDCG@10 and +13.1% MRR@10 at ~246ms/query.
- **Fast-Track Promotion (3 Months):** Promoted from Software Engineer - GenAI to Forward Deployed Engineer at OmniDimension within 90 days; drove 50+ qualified patient consultations in the first month via Odoo & LeadSquared CRM integrations.
